articles.content: Hima Ninama, a Class 11 student, faced pressure to marry at a young age but chose education instead. With the support of her teachers, she successfully stopped the wedding and continued her studies. After excelling in her exams, Hima is now in Class 12 and aspires to become a teacher. She is also passionate about sports, encouraged by her educators despite initial difficulties.
